instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: During an endoscopic procedure, a 46-year-old adult received topical benzocaine. Minutes later, the client develops dyspnea and blue-gray lips. SpO₂ remains 84% despite supplemental oxygen; arterial PaO₂ is 118 mm Hg, and co-oximetry shows methemoglobin 28%. The record documents normal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity. The rapid-response team and prescriber are at the bedside. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the condition, 2 actions, and 2 parameters to monitor.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Wait for pulse oximetry alone to normalize before intervening

actions.label: A2
actions.text: Administer ordered IV methylene blue because G6PD deficiency is excluded

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Stop further oxidant exposure and continue supportive oxygen

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Administer an ordered IV diuretic to remove the oxidant

parameters.label: P1
parameters.text: Serial carboxyhemoglobin and ambient carbon-monoxide levels

parameters.label: P2
parameters.text: Serial methemoglobin by co-oximetry and clinical symptom response

parameters.label: P3
parameters.text: Hemoglobin, indirect bilirubin, haptoglobin, and arterial oxygen assessment

parameters.label: P4
parameters.text: Serum cholinesterase activity and secretion volume
